User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Gaupro platform.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

phone.description: The phone number of the user.

isProfessional.description: Indicates whether the user is a professional service provider.

ProfessionalProfile.title: ProfessionalProfile
ProfessionalProfile.description: Represents the profile of a professional service provider.

id.description: Unique identifier for the professional profile.

companyName.description: The name of the professional's company.

description.description: A description of the professional's services and experience.

servicesOffered.description: A list of services offered by the professional.

certifications.description: A list of certifications held by the professional.

averageRating.description: The average rating of the professional (e.g., 1-5 stars).

ServiceRequest.title: ServiceRequest
ServiceRequest.description: Represents a service request submitted by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service request.

userId.description: Reference to User. (Guest ID or Auth UID)

category.description: The category of service requested (e.g., Plumbing, Electrical).

description.description: A detailed description of the service needed.

location.description: The location where the service is needed.

dateNeeded.description: The date the service is needed.

status.description: The current status (Open, Quoted, In Progress, Completed).

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: Represents a quote provided by a professional.

dateCreated.description: The date the quote was created.

definition.description: Stores professional profiles. Allows public listing.
Top-level collection for all job requests. Enables global search and lead distribution.

firestore.reasoning: Moved ServiceRequest to a top-level collection to allow public writes for guest users without interacting with the strictly-protected /users hierarchy. This ensures better scalability for lead distribution and oversight.
